svg.title: Anishelf layered module architecture
svg.desc: Solid boxes are implemented; dashed amber boxes and dashed connections are proposed V2 additions. Top-down layers: Web presentation, HTTP interface, application coordination, supporting modules and adapters. Arrows identify selected caller-to-dependency relationships. Shared definitions are cross-cutting, not a processing stage.

g.text: Arrow: caller → dependency · Solid: implemented · Dashed amber: planned V2 · Crossings are not junctions
Shared definitions: module models · public policy / formats · DomainError
